references.text: The Lord descended on Mount Sinai in fire, which connects to the description of the Lord's coming from Sinai.
God's revelation in fire at the burning bush on Horeb/Mount Sinai.
Deborah's song describes the Lord's coming from Seir and Edom, with parallel expressions about God's theophany.
Habakkuk's prophecy about God coming from Teman and Mount Paran, with similar theophanic imagery.
The psalm describes God's appearance from Sinai with similar theophanic motifs.
Reference to God's holy ten thousands and his coming from Sinai.
The prophecy of the Lord coming from Edom and Bozrah, with theophanic elements.
Jude quotes Enoch about the Lord coming with his holy ten thousands for judgment.
Hebrews refers to the Sinai revelation with fire and awe-inspiring elements.
Stephen speaks of Moses receiving living words on Mount Sinai.
